reason: The existing isolated preflight validates only paired artifact identity and metadata; it cannot load artifacts or validate a real non-persisted image reference.
No separately governed multimodal OCR runner currently provides the ADR-003 image-reference, invocation, OCR terminal-class, and sanitized-result contract.
Target Vulkan/backend compatibility, projector placement, per-device memory fit, image-token budget, OCR quality, and performance lack local evidence.

design_clarity_note: The named future configuration sequence is a non-executable planning aid only. A future execution issue must retain phase barriers for separate runner implementation and tests, reviewed one-job dry-run, and explicit owner approval before the first image/OCR invocation.
required_next_gate: Create and complete a separate implementation issue, then a separately governed and owner-approved first execution increment. Do not reuse this plan as permission to acquire/process an image or invoke OCR.
